observations: A large head fills the left half, its interior packed with tangled pink, yellow, and teal lines, topped by spiky black-and-yellow hair and wearing blocky red glasses with three rectangular openings.
A small orange figure in the lower right holds up a sign marked with heart symbols; it wears its own pair of red rectangular glasses, echoing the larger head.
Short pale blue dashes scatter across the bright blue background, while two pizza-slice shapes with red toppings float near the upper right corner.
reading: The oversized head lunges forward with bared teeth and a raised hand, its interior a tangle of competing colors that reads as frantic or overstimulated. Two floating pizza slices and the small sign-holding companion add a cartoonish narrative layer. The doubling of the red glasses—large and small figure—creates a visual echo that can feel affectionate or absurd. Scattered blue dashes lend an atmospheric softness unusual among this artist's works in the collection.
contextAngle: In the owned subset, this piece sits next to "pizza pizza pizza day" and "nnxyz #48" by recorded creation order, suggesting a cluster of pizza-titled works. Its readable figures and open staging contrast with the denser, more abstract faces across the nnotb holdings.

connections.reason: Both share a bright blue background and a face built from layered scribbles, but "nnotb #173" fills the frame edge-to-edge while this work isolates its figures in open space.
Both feature recognizable character-like figures with distinct body outlines, unlike the all-over abstraction in many nnotb works, though "nnotb #9" uses warm tones where this piece relies on blue.

lookingQuestion: How does the small orange figure at lower right change your reading of the large head—does it seem like a companion, an audience, or something else entirely?
ambiguities: The floating objects near the upper right appear to be pizza slices consistent with the title, but their shapes are loose enough to be read otherwise.
Whether the pale blue dashes represent rain, confetti, or a purely decorative texture is not determinable from the image alone.
